title: Canonical Standard Execution catalog port has no Product provider
actual: CpfExecutionCatalogPort has zero implementation/provider candidates while AdmStandardExecutionController requires it. Three ACTIVE DB3 query statements declare nonexistent CpfExecutionCatalogRepository as consumer.
rootCause: The public port, canonical CPF_STANDARD_EXECUTION tables, DB3 templates and ADM endpoints were delivered without the runtime repository/AutoConfiguration wiring, leaving an interface-only/metadata-only feature.
repairOwner: Platform Operations runtime-control JDBC repository and AutoConfiguration using CpfVendorSqlCatalog
falseGreenForbidden: Do not add a no-op bean, in-memory fallback, optional controller injection, or mark the DB3 statements STAGED.
